name: Chasing the Sun
source:
A brief meditation on light and beauty and living life.

A somewhat experimental kinetic novel made up of photographs and first-person narration, without any characters per se.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=13944]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
